views.photoPattern: Front-facing dog has a broad white facial blaze, white muzzle and cheeks, white chest and lower legs, with tan coloring across the forehead and outer face.
views.spritePattern: South sprite shows a centered white blaze, white muzzle and lower face, white chest/front area and pale lower paws, with tan forehead and side-face coloring.
views.evidence: The main visible facial and front-body fur patches correspond in position: centered blaze, pale muzzle/chest, and tan surrounding face. Softer pixel-art contrast and simplified patch edges do not remove the markings.

nonCoatIdentity.evidence: The sprite preserves upright triangular ears, a short tapered muzzle, and a compact upright front-facing body silhouette. Coat length is simplified by the 32px style but does not show a concrete identity mismatch.
